title: Vehicle Interior Noise on Electric Vehicles
seoDescription: GRAS microphones for vehicle interior NVH on electric vehicles: road and component noise, cabin measurement challenges and recommended microphone systems.

props.title: Vehicle Interior Noise on Electric Vehicles
paragraphs: Interior noise, vibration and harshness (NVH) covers all noise inside the vehicle that comes from the road, body, chassis and components. Road noise is structure-borne and airborne, and component noise comes from systems such as HVAC and power windows.

Measuring inside the cabin is harder on an electric vehicle than on a combustion vehicle: more high-frequency content makes TPA and ENR measurements difficult, and a distributed powertrain with wind, road and tyre noise makes pressure microphones more relevant than directional free-field microphones.

image.alt: Vehicle Interior Noise on Electric Vehicles

props.body:
- Active noise cancellation is hard to control in the cabin, and uncontrolled phase can amplify the noise
- Passive measures such as acoustic packages and anti-vibration mounts remain in use and must be adapted to the new environment
